notes:
# Move recordings to a drive {drive}
Running out of space? Move to… puts a meeting's video on an external drive
or a cloud folder. Its transcript and notes stay here, and it plays from the
drive whenever it's plugged in.

# Send a meeting to someone {import}
Export… makes one file with the recording, transcript and notes. They
double-click it and it's in their RecordLah!. The Zoom link and passcode
are never included.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Alerts now look like RecordLah!, and list each item with what went wrong.
- With the microphone switched off for RecordLah!, a recording still records
  the meeting. Only your voice is left out.
- In Select, shift-click starts from the open meeting, and ticks no longer
  disappear when the list updates.
- File › Export Meeting exports the meeting you have open.
- Help has a new section on moving and sharing recordings.
